name: Font Awesome 6 Regular
about: Font Awesome 6 Regular is a free, open-source icon set with 164 icons designed by Dave Gandy. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

faqs.q: Are Font Awesome 6 Regular free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 164 Font Awesome 6 Regular are open source under the CC BY 4.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC BY 4.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Font Awesome 6 Regular in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Font Awesome 6 Regular are there?
faqs.a: There are 164 icons in the Font Awesome 6 Regular set, designed by Dave Gandy. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Font Awesome 6 Regular?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Font Awesome 6 Regular available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
